         1                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

         2       would you please recognize Senator Thompson to

         3       speak on Legislative Resolution Number 1207,

         4       which was previously adopted by this house,

         5       which commemorates today's 39th anniversary of

         6       Earth Day.

         7                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         8       Senator Thompson.

         9                  SENATOR THOMPSON:    Thank you.

        10       Thank you.  First let me thank you, Madam

        11       President, for recognizing me, and the floor

        12       leader as well.

        13                  This is the 39th official national

        14       anniversary of Earth Day.  And I think that

        15       this is a historic time not only in our state

        16       but also in our nation.  And many people --

        17       just this morning, I was thinking, I was

        18       watching television, and on all the major

        19       networks, the morning shows -- and in fact

        20       this entire week -- you're seeing so much

        21       attention on environmental issues.

        22                  And clearly, because of the efforts

        23       in Washington under President Barack Obama,

        24       people are really tuned into environmental



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         3660



         1       issues.

         2                  And today I think we stand at a

         3       critical point in our state in terms of making

         4       sure that New York assumes its rightful place

         5       in providing strong leadership on

         6       environmental issues.  Basically, it's always

         7       California or New York that used to lead the

         8       agenda, and we have made some good progress on

         9       a number of issues over the years.

        10                  But now, I believe now is our time.

        11       Now is the time of the New York State

        12       Legislature and the Governor to really catch

        13       up and pick up the pace on issues as it

        14       relates to the environment.

        15                  And so I say that today not only do

        16       we celebrate Earth Day, but that New York

        17       assumes its rightful place as a leader on the

        18       environment in the United States of America.

        19       Now is the time that we move forward on issues

        20       like climate change, SEQRA standing, green

        21       schools and green museums, and pushing forward

        22       on green jobs in the State of New York.

        23                  As a runner, someone who runs each

        24       and every day, I say that now is time for us



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         3661



         1       as well to pick up the pace on environmental

         2       justice.  This year we were very successful in

         3       expanding the Bigger Better Bottle Bill, which

         4       will remove more products off of our beaches,

         5       off of our farms and out of our parks, both

         6       city, suburban and rural.

         7                  I conclude by saying that there is

         8       so much work to do on the environment in the

         9       State of New York.  Other states are moving

        10       rapidly ahead, but we must work together in a

        11       bipartisan way, in both houses of the

        12       Legislature, to make sweeping changes that not

        13       only protect us today but protects the future

        14       generations.  If we don't do that, if we don't

        15       take that message seriously, then shame on us.

        16                  But we can get work done.  I look

        17       forward to a number of the very positive bills

        18       that members on both sides of the aisle have

        19       introduced in the Senate that are coming

        20       through our committee.  And if they are good

        21       bills, we will do everything we can to move

        22       those good bills forward.

        23                  And I thank you for the few

        24       moments.  And happy Earth Day to all of my



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         3662



         1       colleagues and to the residents of the State

         2       of New York.

         3                  Thank you and God bless you.

         8       Madam President.

         9                  I rise to, one, thank my colleague

        10       for bringing forth this resolution on Earth

        11       Day.

        12                  I have only one very serious

        13       problem with this resolution or resolutions

        14       like it, when we celebrate Mother's Day or

        15       Father's Day and then the rest of the year we

        16       kind of forget about it.  I don't think we can

        17       afford to do that.  Not for Mother's Day or

        18       Father's Day or Patriot's Day or Memorial Day

        19       or any one of these days.

        20                  Every day of the year has to be an

        21       environmental day.  Every day of the year we

        22       should be celebrating clean air, clear water,

        23       open space, quality living conditions, good

        24       neighborhoods, good schools, good housing,



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         3663



         1       safe streets.  All of these things should be

         2       on our agenda and on our minds every single

         3       day.

         4                  While it's good that we celebrate,

         5       it's good that we announce, and it's good that

         6       we remind the public and we remind each other

         7       that this is a day we use to commemorate the

         8       achievements that we have made, the progress

         9       that we have made on improving our

        10       environment -- because we have.

        11                  And, Senator, New York State has

        12       been a leader in the environment.  We have

        13       passed more legislation of an environmental

        14       significance than any other state in the

        15       union.  We have led constantly, and we will

        16       continue to be leaders, as you say, working

        17       together in a truly bipartisan way.  Because

        18       there is no such thing as a Republican

        19       environment or a Democrat environment or a

        20       liberal environment or a conservative

        21       environment.  The environment is there for all

        22       of us to use and to preserve and protect.

        23                  It isn't ours.  This planet is not

        24       ours.  We don't own it.  We kind of rent space



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         3664



         1       on it for a while, but we don't own it.  Our

         2       job is to make it better than we found it for

         3       future generations.  Now, so far I give us a

         4       C minus on that.  We've got a long way to go.

         5       We've got a long way to go.

         6                  And as a former schoolteacher, I

         7       look forward, I look forward to saying one day

         8       and giving us an A grade for the work we've

         9       done on the environment.  But we're a long way

        10       from that.

        11                  Senator, let's work together in the

        12       right way to make this place, make this planet

        13       a safer place, to make it a cleaner place and

        14       a better place for our children and our

        15       grandchildren.
